concerns.text: T003 (Generate validation_report.json) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depends on T001 and T002 completing successfully to fetch metadata and verify variables. Parallel execution risks race conditions where T003 runs before T001/T002 finish, producing an incomplete or invalid report. T003 must be sequential or explicitly depend on T001/T002 completion.

T005d (Generate state YAML) is marked [P] but explicitly lists 'Dependency: T005c (Git Init)'. Parallel execution of T005d before T005c completes will fail because the git repository (required for state tracking context) won't exist. T005d must be sequential after T005c.

T012 (Contract test for data schema) is marked [P] but explicitly lists 'Dependency: Requires T009a/b completion'. Running T012 in parallel with T009a/b risks the test executing before the schema files are written to disk, causing a FileNotFoundError. T012 must be sequential after T009a/b.

T024 (Finalize Aligned Dataset) is marked [P] but explicitly lists dependencies on T016 (excluded_subjects.csv), T023 (filtered data), and T022b (learning_phase). Parallel execution violates the producer-consumer flow; T024 cannot merge artifacts that haven't been generated. T024 must be sequential after T016, T022b, and T023.

T028 (FDR correction) is marked [P] but depends on T027 (LME fitting) output. T029 (Permutation test) also depends on T027. Running these in parallel with T027 or before T027 completes will result in missing input data. T028 and T029 must be sequential after T027.

T040 (Lagged Window Sanity Check) is marked [P] but logically depends on the output of T022 (Lagged Alignment) to validate the windows. If T040 runs before T022, it has no data to check. While T040 could be a separate validation step, the current [P] tag implies it can run independently of T022's completion, which is semantically incorrect for a sanity check on T022's output.
